blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent’s context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task’s structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning ( RV-ICL ) , a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.
blocks.zh: LLM代理商通过文本内存协调了被冻结的视觉语言动作(VLA)政策,改善了各个事件,文本内存记录了代理商做了什么,但没有记录任务是如何完成的. 影片显示, 整个视频会减慢每个转弯,固定的键框会失去决定一个抓取是否维持的接触细节,以及代理商需要从任务结构在规划时转向每个接触周围的帧. 将演示变成代理导航的分级, 分级由演示的子事件所建立,如抓取和释放. 其水平越来越精细,从整个任务的关键框架到阶段、瞬间和短片,并通过只读工具被曝光。 代理人在规划前会读出粗细的级别. 在执行过程中,当一个步骤需要更多细节时,它就会重新进入等级体系,只装入当前子目标的片段. 每个任务一个示范就够了。 在RPent上建造的RV-ICL将LIBERO-PRO上的成功率从92.6%提高到96.5%,在LIBERO-Plus上的成功率从86.7%提高到95.8%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as the deliberative layer of robot systems. They decompose instructions, localise objects, and call learned visuomotor policies for the contact-rich steps they cannot perform analytically ( Ahn et al., 2022 ; Liang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2022 ) . Recent agentic harnesses push this design further. HarnessVLA ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , released as the RPent framework, exposes a frozen VLA as one retryable primitive among a few analytic ones. A coding agent orchestrates them and improves across episodes through text memory : recipes, lessons and failure rules. Under distribution shift, this design outperforms end-to-end VLAs by a wide margin.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)作为机器人系统的议事层被越来越多地部署. 它们分解指令,将对象本地化,并调用他们无法分析的多接触步骤所学到的粘接电动机政策(Ahn等,2022;Liang等,2023;Huang等,2022)。 近期的干燥绳能进一步推动这个设计. HarnesVLA (Zhang等, 2026c.),作为RPent框架发布,将被冷冻的VLA暴露为少数分析中可再试的原始. 一个编码代理通过文本内存(:食谱,教训和失败规则)来协调并改进各集. 在分配转移中,这种设计以相差相去甚远的优势,超越了终端到终端的VLA.

blocks.en: How far the agent can improve, however, is bounded by what text can record. The agent writes its memory from its own execution traces, so the memory describes its calls and their outcomes rather than the task itself. It can record that a grasp failed, but not what a successful execution looks like: which object is taken first, from which side the hand approaches, how high the object is lifted, when the gripper opens. Such knowledge is spatial and temporal, and it is hard to put into words.
blocks.zh: 然而,代理人能够改进的程度取决于能够记录哪些文本。 代理从自己的执行痕迹来写出记忆,因此记忆描述了它的呼唤和结果,而不是任务本身. 它可以记录一个抓取失败,但不能记录成功执行的外观:哪个对象先被取走,手从哪一边走来,物体升起多高,当抓取者打开. 这种知识是空间和时间的,很难用言语表达。

blocks.en: What is hard to put into words is easy to show: a video of the task captures all of it, frame by frame. Such a video is also cheap to obtain. A human demonstration only requires recording a person actually performing the task, with no action labels or other annotation. Large models can learn from demonstrations placed in their context, in text ( Brown et al., 2020 ) and with interleaved images ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ) . This suggests letting the agent watch a demonstration of its task, much as a person watches a how-to video before trying something new.
blocks.zh: 难以放入文字的内容是容易显示的:一个任务视频可以捕捉到全部,被帧. 这种录像也便宜取出. 人类的演示只要求记录实际完成任务的人,没有动作标签或其他注释. 大型模型可以从置于上下文的演示、文本(Brown等,2020年)和取相片图像(Alayrac等,2022年)中学习。 这说明让特工看任务演示,

blocks.en: But in what form should the video enter the agent’s memory? The obvious answers fail for three reasons. (i) Length. A demonstration spans hundreds of frames, and the agent re-reads its whole context at each of its tens to hundreds of turns. Long contexts also degrade how well models use their content ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . (ii) Resolution. A few keyframes are affordable, but they drop the frames around each contact, which decide whether a grasp holds or a placement registers. (iii) Timing. What the agent needs changes over the episode: the task’s structure before it acts, and the frames around a particular contact once it reaches that step. No fixed presentation of the video can satisfy all three constraints at once.
blocks.zh: 但视频应该以什么形式输入代理的记忆? 显而易见的答案由于三个原因而失败. (一) 长度。 一次演示跨越了上百个帧,代理在其上到上百个转折的每个转折处重新读取其整个上下文. 较长的上下文还贬低了模型使用其内容的程度(Liu等人,2024年)。 (二) 决议。 几个关键框架是负担得起的,但它们将框架放在每个联系人周围,由它来决定抓好还是放置登记册。 (三) 时间安排。 代理商在剧情上需要改变什么:任务行动前的结构,以及特定接触一旦达到这个步骤时的相框. 视频的任何固定展示都不能同时满足所有三个制约因素.

blocks.en: Since each moment of the episode calls for a different part of the demonstration, why not let the agent watch just that part, and only at that moment? Methods for long documents and long videos already take this route: instead of reading everything, the language model navigates a hierarchical index ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Packer et al., 2023 ) . We bring this idea to embodied agents, which decide from their own progress when to look closer: before a delicate contact, at the start of a new sub-goal, or after a step goes wrong.
blocks.zh: 由于剧集的每分每秒都要求进行不同的演示部分,为什么不让特工只看那部分,只在那个时候? 长文档和长视频的方法已经走这条路线:语言模型不是阅读一切,而是导航分级索引(Sarthi等,2024;Wang等,2024;Packer等,2023)。 我们把这一想法带给体现的代理人,他们从自己的进步中决定何时更密切地看待:在进行微妙接触之前,在开始一个新的分目标之前,或在一步步出错之后。

blocks.en: We build such an index over a demonstration and call the method Recursive Video In-Context Learning ( RV-ICL ) . The index is a tree whose levels grow finer: event-driven keyframes of the whole task, the phases between sub-events, the moments around each sub-event, and short clips from any camera ( Figure 1 a). The agent reads the coarse levels before planning and does not collect clips up front. Whenever it needs more detail during execution, the agent re-enters the tree at the node of its current sub-goal and pulls only the relevant clip ( Figure 1 b). The demonstration is thus consulted recursively, at the level of detail and the moment the agent’s progress calls for.
blocks.zh: 我们通过示范来建立这样一个索引,并称为递归视频内文学习法。 该索引是一棵树,其级别会变细:整个任务由事件驱动的键框,子事件之间的相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 经纪人在规划前会读出粗放的级别,不会收集到前面的剪辑. 执行过程中需要更多细节时,代理人会在其当前子目标的节点再入树上并只取出相关剪接(图1b). 因此,在详细程度和代理人的进展需要之时,就反复地咨询示威。

blocks.en: RV-ICL requires no training, no change to the VLA, and one demonstration per base task. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, the instants at which one sub-task ends and the next begins. The same construction therefore applies to any task that decomposes into sub-tasks. We make the following contributions: • We introduce video in-context learning to tool-using robot agents: their text memory cannot record what a successful execution looks like, but a demonstration video shows it frame by frame ( Section 3.1 ). • We propose Recursive Video In-Context Learning ( RV-ICL ), which lets the agent look only at the part of the demonstration its current step needs, by giving it recursive access to a hierarchy built from the demonstration’s sub-events ( Section 3 ). • On LIBERO-PRO, RV-ICL raises the success rate of HarnessVLA from 92.6% to 96.5%, above every baseline, and on LIBERO-Plus from 86.7% to 95.8% across seven kinds of perturbation. On the long LIBERO-10 tasks it gains up to 12 points, where keyframes or the whole video of the same demonstration gain at most 2 ( Section 5 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 LLM agents for robot manipulation
blocks.zh: 2.1 机器人操纵的LLM剂

blocks.en: Language models entered robotics as planners over pre-trained skills. SayCan ( Ahn et al., 2022 ) scores LLM proposals by learned affordances, ProgPrompt ( Singh et al., 2023 ) and Code as Policies ( Liang et al., 2023 ) write programs over perception and control APIs, and VoxPoser ( Huang et al., 2023 ) composes 3D value maps for a motion planner. Inner Monologue ( Huang et al., 2022 ) feeds execution feedback back to the planner, and Voyager ( Wang et al., 2023 ) accumulates a library of verified skills.
blocks.zh: 语言模型作为规划者进入机器人专业,超越了预先训练的技能. SayCan(Ahn等,2022年)通过博学的支付能力评分LLM建议,ProgPrompt(Singh等,2023年)和代码为Policy(Liang等,2023年)为感知和控制API编写程序,而VoxPoser(Huang等,2023年)为一个运动规划者绘制了3D值地图. 内部单曲(Huang等,2022年)将执行反馈反馈给计划者,而Voyager(Wang等,2023年)则积累了经核实的技能库.

blocks.en: A recent line of agentic harnesses puts a coding agent in charge of a frozen VLA. HarnessVLA ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) exposes the VLA as a retryable primitive and learns its operating range from text memory; Robo-Harness K1 ( Li et al., 2026 ) augments such agents with perception; CaP-X ( Fu et al., 2026 ) benchmarks coding agents for manipulation; RATS ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) learns through play; and RAPID ( Liu et al., 2026 ) synthesises agent programs from demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 近代一行的特制绳把一个编码剂负责被冻结的VLA. HarnessVLA (Zhang等,2026c)将VLA暴露为可重试的原始体并学习其操作范围从文字记忆;Robo-Harness K1 (Li等,2026年)以感知增强此类剂;CaP-X (Fu等,2026年)为操纵用的基准编码剂;RATS (Zhang等,2026a)从游戏中学习;RAPID(Liu等,2026年)从演示中合成剂方案.

blocks.en: The knowledge these systems carry across episodes is textual or programmatic. RV-ICL keeps the harness unchanged and adds a visual record of how the task is performed, together with a protocol for consulting it.
blocks.zh: 这些系统所携带的知识是文字或程序。 RV-ICL保持了吊带不变并增加了任务执行的可视记录,以及咨询协议.

blocks.en: 2.2 Learning from demonstrations in context
blocks.zh: 2.2 从示威中吸取教训

blocks.en: In language models, a few demonstrations in the prompt suffice to specify a task ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , although models draw mostly on their format and label space rather than the exact input–label mapping ( Min et al., 2022 ) . Flamingo ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ) extends in-context learning to interleaved images.
blocks.zh: 在语言模型中,即时的一些演示足以指定一项任务(Brown等,2020年),尽管模型大多取材于其格式和标签空间,而不是精确输入-标签映射(Min等,2022年). 火烈鸟 (Alayrac等,2022年)将内文学习扩展为互出相通图像.

blocks.en: In robotics, one-shot imitation has been learned by meta-learning from human videos ( Yu et al., 2018 ) and by video-conditioned policies ( Jain et al., 2024 ) . In-context imitation has been achieved by tokenising demonstrations as keypoints for an off-the-shelf LLM ( Di Palo and Johns, 2024 ) , by training a policy to continue interleaved demonstration trajectories ( Fu et al., 2024 ) , and by conditioning a VLA on structured demonstrations ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . When an LLM acts directly as the policy, one-shot demonstrations yield no aggregate gain ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 在机器人方面,通过从人类视频中元相学习(Yu等,2018年)和以视频为条件的政策(Jain等,2024年),学习了一发相仿. 通过将示威作为现成LLM(Di Palo and Johns, 2024)的关键点, 培训继续互放演示轨迹的政策(Fu等人, 2024), 以及对结构化的示威进行VLA(Xu等人, 2026), 当LLM直接作为政策时,一发一发的演示不会产生总的收益(张等,2026b.).

blocks.en: All of these present the demonstration once, as a prefix for the next actions. Our agent makes tens to hundreds of decisions per episode, so the question is not only whether to show a demonstration but which part, and when .
blocks.zh: 所有这些人都会展示一次,作为下一步行动的前缀. 我们的经纪人每集做上到上百个决定, 所以问题不仅在于是否要展示,

blocks.en: 2.3 Recursion in language-model reasoning and retrieval
blocks.zh: 2.3 语言模式推理和检索的回顾

blocks.en: Recursion lets a bounded model handle inputs and problems that exceed its context. Recursive summarisation condenses a book into a tree of summaries read top-down ( Wu et al., 2021 ) , and RAPTOR ( Sarthi et al., 2024 ) retrieves from such a tree at the level of abstraction a question requires. For long videos, VideoAgent ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and VideoTree ( Wang et al., 2025 ) likewise inspect only the frames or branches a question needs.
blocks.zh: 复用让有界限的模型处理超出上下文的输入和问题. 递归概括将一书收缩成一棵被从上而下读取的摘要树(Wu等,2021年),而RAPTOR(Sarthi等,2024年)则从这种树取回到一个问题所要求的抽象程度. 对于长视频,VideoAgent(Wang等,2024年)和VideoTree(Wang等,2025年)同样只检查需要提问的帧或分支.

blocks.en: Recursive decomposition splits a problem as needed. ADaPT ( Prasad et al., 2024 ) decomposes a sub-task further only when the executor fails on it, THREAD ( Schroeder et al., 2025 ) spawns child threads that return only what the parent needs, and Recursive Language Models ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) call themselves over slices of a context too long to read at once. Tree of Thoughts ( Yao et al., 2023 ) searches over such trees of intermediate steps.
blocks.zh: 递归分解按需要分解出一个问题. ADAPT(Prasad等,2024年)只在执行器失效时再进一步分解出子任务,THREAD(Schroeder等,2025年)产出只返回父母需要的童线,Recursive Language Models(Zhang等,2025年)称自己在一个上下文片段上过长,一次读不完. 思想之树 (姚等,2023年) 在这种中间阶梯的树上进行搜索.

blocks.en: A related family decides when to fetch information. FLARE ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) retrieves when upcoming tokens are uncertain, and Self-RAG ( Asai et al., 2024 ) learns to request retrieval on demand. Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) and Self-Refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) feed the outcome of an attempt into the next one, and MemGPT ( Packer et al., 2023 ) pages information between a bounded context and external storage.
blocks.zh: 相关家庭决定何时获取信息。 FLARE(Jiang等,2023年)在即将到来的信使不确定时进行检索,而自发RAG(Asai等,2024年)学习根据要求请求检索. Reflexion (Shinn等,2023年)和self-Refine (Madaan等,2023年)为下一次尝试的结果提供素材,而MemGPT (Packer等,2023年)在被约束的上下文和外部存储之间页面信息.

blocks.en: RV-ICL brings recursion to an embodied agent. The demonstration is a tree read at the level each decision requires, and the agent descends whenever its progress in the physical task calls for more detail: before a delicate contact, at a new sub-goal, or after a step goes wrong.
blocks.zh: RV-ICL给一个被体现的代理带来重复. 演示是一棵在每一决定需要的级别上被读取的树,当代理人在实际任务中的进展需要更详细时,即会降入:在微妙的接触之前,在新的分目标上,或在一步出错后.

blocks.zh: 3 递录视频内文学习

Robot tools execute on the environment, and read-only demonstration tools load a level of the hierarchy into the agent’s context. The agent reads the coarse levels ( L 0 L_{0} – L 2 L_{2} ) before planning and loads a clip whenever its current sub-goal needs more detail.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem setting
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题设置

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We first test whether RV-ICL improves a strong agentic system under distribution shift ( Section 5.1 ) and whether recursive access beats showing the agent keyframes or the whole video ( Section 5.2 ). We then examine how agents use the hierarchy ( Section 5.3 ) and whether the gains hold on a second benchmark with other kinds of perturbation ( Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先检验RV-ICL是否改进了分销转移下的强代理系统(第5.1节),以及循环访问是否比显示代理键框或整个视频(第5.2节)都要好。 然后,我们审查代理人如何使用等级制度(第5.3节),收益是否与其他种类的扰动一样维持在第二个基准上(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: Our main benchmark is LIBERO-PRO ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , which perturbs the four LIBERO suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, LIBERO-10; Liu et al., 2023 ) by instruction redirection (T) and position swap (S). Each of the eight cells contains 10 tasks. We follow the evaluation protocol of Zhang et al. (2026c) , whose reported baselines use 10 seeds per task. We evaluate RV-ICL with 5 seeds per task, so each of our cells aggregates 50 episodes. To test other kinds of perturbation we use LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , which perturbs the LIBERO tasks along seven dimensions: object layout, camera viewpoint, robot initial state, language, lighting, background and sensor noise. LIBERO-Plus contains 10,030 perturbed variants, so we evaluate a stratified subset of 120. It takes three variants of each of the 40 base tasks and rotates the seven dimensions over them, which gives 17 or 18 variants per dimension. Variants are drawn from the hardest difficulty levels available, and 105 of the 120 come from the two hardest of the five levels. Both methods use the same initial state for every variant. The agent receives the text memory of the unperturbed base task. On LIBERO-Plus we run HarnessVLA ourselves with the same agent. Since this protocol differs from the official one, these numbers compare the two methods with each other, not with the public leaderboard.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要基准是LIBERO-PRO(周等,2025年),它通过指令重定向(T)和位置交换(S)来扰动四个LIBERO套房(空间,对象,目标,LIBERO-10;刘等,2023年). 8个单元中每个单元包含10个任务. 我们遵循张等的评价协议(2026c),其报告的基线每任务使用10个种子. 我们每个任务用5个种子来评估RV-ICL, 所以每个细胞都聚集了50集. 为了测试其他类型的扰动,我们使用LIBERO-Plus(Fei等,2025年),它使LIBERO的任务围绕七个维度来进行:物体布局,相机视角,机器人初始状态,语言,照明,背景和传感器噪音. LIBERO-Plus包含有10,030个扰动变体,因此我们评价一个分层子集120个. 它需要40个基础任务中每个任务的三个变体,并围绕它们旋转7个维相,每个维相给出17个或18个变体. 备选案文取自现有最困难的等级,120个等级中的105个来自五个等级中最困难的两个等级。 两种方法对每种变体都使用相同的初始状态. 代理接收了未被扰动的碱性任务的文本内存. 在LIBERO -Plus上,我们自己运行哈内斯VLA 与同一代理。 由于这个协议与官方协议不同,这些数字将两种方法相互比较,而不是与公共领导板比较.

blocks.en: We build one hierarchy per LIBERO base task from the first of its human teleoperation demonstrations. The keyframes are re-rendered at 512 px from the recorded simulator states, and the clips use the 128 px frames recorded during teleoperation. Both are shown in the orientation of the agent’s own cameras (third-person and wrist), so that demonstration and live views are directly comparable. Replaying the recorded states also gives the object and joint states that L 1 L_{1} uses to state what each phase achieved. Both benchmarks use K = 16 K{=}16 keyframes, and a clip holds at most 20 frames ( Appendix B ). One hierarchy serves every perturbed variant of its base task in LIBERO-PRO and LIBERO-Plus. In the instruction-redirection (T) cells, whose goal differs from the demonstrated one, the agent is told which parts of the demonstration no longer apply.
blocks.zh: 我们从第一次人类远程行动演示开始,每一次LIBERO基地任务就建立一个等级. 键框从所记录的模拟状态下以512 px重接,片段使用在远程操作中记录的128 px帧. 两者都以代理机自身相机(第三人称相机和手腕相机)的取向来显示,因此演示和活视可以直接比较. 重放所记录的状态也给予对象和联合状态,L 1 LQQ1}用于说明每个相实现的. 这两种基准都使用K=16KQQ16键框,并有一个夹片最多可容纳20个帧(附录B)。 在LIBERO-PRO和LIBERO-Plus中,其基本任务的每一起变化都有一个等级。 在指示-再定向(T)单元格中,其目标与所显示的不同,它被告知演示的哪些部分不再适用.

blocks.en: On LIBERO-PRO we compare with eight VLAs (OpenVLA, π 0 \pi_{0} , π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , MolmoAct, NORA, X-VLA, AtomVLA and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} fine-tuned with RLinf), two agentic systems (Cap-X and RATS), and HarnessVLA with three planners. All baseline numbers are taken from Zhang et al. (2026c) . We define the ablation arms in Section 5.2 .
blocks.zh: 关于LIBERO-PRO,我们比较了8个VLA(OpenVLA, π0\pi_{0}, π 0.5\pi_{0.5), Molmo Act, NORA, X-VLA, AtomVLA 和 π 0.5\pi_{0.5) , 两个代理系统(Cap-X和RATS), 和 HarnesVLA 三个规划者。 所有基准数取自张等 (2026c). 我们在第5.2节中定义了消耗性武器。

blocks.en: The primary metric is task success rate, read from the simulator’s own goal check. On LIBERO-PRO the baseline numbers come from separate runs, so we test the gap in success rate pooled over the eight cells with a two-proportion z-test ( Section 5.1 ). To study how agents use the hierarchy, we log every demonstration call with its level, the phase or moment it shows, its camera and its turn. We also measure the cost of an episode in wall-clock time and tokens ( Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 主要衡量标准是任务成功率,从模拟器自己的目标检查中读取。 在LIBERO-PRO上,基线数字来自单独的跑道,因此,我们用两种比例的z-测试法(第5.1节)测试8个细胞的成功率差距。 为了研究代理人如何使用等级,我们记录每个演示呼叫的级别,显示的相或相,相机和相机的转动. 我们还按一集的时钟时间和符号衡量成本(附录D)。

blocks.en: The agent is gpt-6-astra at low reasoning effort running in the Codex CLI, as in the strongest HarnessVLA configuration. RV-ICL does not depend on this choice. It only adds read-only tools and a prompt section to the harness and changes nothing specific to the model, so any agent the harness supports can use the same demonstration hierarchy, for example Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 ( Appendix C ). The VLA primitive is π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} fine-tuned by RLinf on LIBERO and served locally, and SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) provides segmentation. Each episode is a single attempt.

blocks.en: Table 1 reports success on the eight LIBERO-PRO cells for end-to-end VLAs, agentic systems and RV-ICL . HarnessVLA lets a GPT-6 Astra agent call the end-to-end VLA π RLinf \pi_{\mathrm{RLinf}} as a tool and raises its success by 42.6 points to 92.6%. RV-ICL adds recursive access to demonstration clips on top of HarnessVLA and raises success by another 3.9 points to 96.5%. A two-proportion z-test on the pooled cells shows that this gain is significant ( z = 2.97 z=2.97 , two-sided p = 0.003 p=0.003 ).
blocks.zh: 表1报告了8个LIBERO-PRO细胞在从端到端的VLA、代理系统和RV-ICL方面的成功。 HarnessVLA让一款GPT-6 Astra代理将端到端的VLA → RLinf\pi_{\-mathrm{RLinf}}作为工具,并提升了42.6分到92.6%. RV-ICL在HarnessVLA上增加了对演示片段的递归访问,并将成功率再提升了3.9分到96.5%. 对集合细胞进行双比例的z-测试显示,这一增益是显著的(z= 2.97 z= 2.97,双侧p=0.003 p=0.003).

blocks.en: While keeping the other five cells at or near the ceiling, RV-ICL brings clear gains on the three cells where HarnessVLA is weakest. Goal-T rises from 88.0 to 100.0, L10-T from 85.0 to 90.0 and L10-S from 72.0 to 84.0. LIBERO-10 is the long-horizon suite of the benchmark, and each of its tasks chains several grasps and releases. The gains there suggest that recursive access is especially effective on such tasks. The small drop on Goal-S (98.0 vs. 99.0) comes from a single failed episode. With five seeds per task, one episode moves a cell by two points. So the drop does not indicate that RV-ICL is worse than HarnessVLA on Goal-S .
blocks.zh: 在将其他五个细胞保持在或接近天花板的同时,RV-ICL为HarnesVLA最弱的三个细胞带来了明显的收益. 目标-T从88.0升至100.0;L10-T从85.0升至90.0;L10-S从72.0升至84.0. LIBERO-10是基准的长视距套件,其每一项任务都连锁了好几种抓取和放出. 取得的进展表明,循环准入对于这些任务特别有效。 在Goal-S(98.0 vs 99.0)上小幅下降来自一集失败. 每个任务有5个种子,一集将一个细胞移动了2分. RV-ICL在目标-S上比HarnessVLA更差。

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.2 违约

blocks.en: We ablate the form in which the demonstration enters the agent’s context. All arms share the agent and the text memory and run on the two LIBERO-10 cells, which hold the longest tasks: • Text : HarnessVLA with text memory only. • Keyframes : only the event-driven keyframes of the demonstration ( L 0 L_{0} ). • Full video : the whole demonstration video, with no hierarchy. • RV-ICL : the full hierarchy ( L 0 L_{0} – L 3 L_{3} ) with recursive access ( Section 3.3 ). Table 2 reports the results. The Text and RV-ICL rows are taken from the LIBERO-10 cells of Table 1 . Showing the demonstration is not enough on its own. Keyframes raise success over text memory by only 1.0 point on L10-T and 2.0 points on L10-S. The full video is 1.0 point below text memory on L10-T and 6.0 points below it on L10-S. RV-ICL is the best arm on both cells, with 90.0% on L10-T and 84.0% on L10-S. Its lead is largest on L10-S, the harder cell for every arm, where it is 10.0 points above keyframes and 18.0 points above the full video.

blocks.en: All three video arms show the same demonstration in different forms. Keyframes are coarse. They show where the gripper closes and opens but not how a grasp or a release is carried out. They are also what RV-ICL reads before planning, so the gap between the two arms comes from the phase map and the clips. The full video holds that detail but has no index into it, so the agent must find the moment it needs among unrelated frames. RV-ICL keeps the detail and adds the index, whose text levels tell the agent which clip to ask for. The agent reads the coarse levels first and opens a clip only when a sub-goal calls for it, so the detail it sees is the detail it is about to use. The gap to the full video suggests that what helps is not seeing more but seeing the right part at the right time.
blocks.zh: 三个视频臂都以不同形式展示了同样的演示. 键框粗糙. 它们显示抓取器关闭和打开的地方,但不显示如何进行抓取或释放。 它们也是RV-ICL在规划前所读到的,因此两臂间的差距来自于相位图和相片. 整个视频中包含着这个细节,但没有任何索引,所以代理商必须在不相关的帧中找到它需要的瞬间. RV-ICL保存细节并添加索引,其文本关卡告诉代理要要求哪个剪辑. 代理人首先读出粗细的关卡,并只在子目标需要时才打开剪辑,所以它所看到的是即将使用的细节. 与完整视频的空隙表明,有帮助的不是看到更多,而是看到合适的时间。

blocks.en: 5.3 How agents recurse

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows what a re-entry gives the agent. After the failed grasp it asks for the grasp moment alone and reads from the clip how the demonstrator holds the pot: by the handle, with the fingers farther out than its own. Where that handle lies in its own scene it determines from its own cameras, since the demonstration was recorded in another layout. The clip thus supplies what text memory cannot record, and nothing else from the video enters the context.
blocks.zh: 图3显示复入给剂的. 在失败的抓取之后,它要求只掌握一个抓取的时刻,并从剪辑中读出显示者如何握住锅:用手柄,手指比自己的手指更远. 在它自己的场景中 它从自己的相机中决定 因为示威是用另一种布局记录的 片段因此提供了文本内存无法记录的内容,视频中没有任何内容进入上下文.

blocks.en: In 97% of the episodes the agent re-enters the demonstration during execution. It asks for short moments far more often than for whole phases: of the clip views, 40% are grasp moments, 30% release moments, 15% fixture or end-of-task moments and 16% whole phases (rounded). Re-entries cluster in the second half of an episode (78%), when the agent is executing contacts rather than planning. Longer tasks call for more of them, from 2.3 per episode on Object to 10.4 on LIBERO-10.
blocks.zh: 在97%的事件中,特工在处决期间再次进入示威活动. 它要求短暂的瞬间比整个阶段要多得多:在剪辑视图中,40%是抓取瞬间,30%是放出瞬间,15%是固定或任务结束瞬间,16%是整个相(圆形). 在一个剧集后半部分(78%)重新进入集群,当代理执行联系人而不是计划. 较长的任务需要更多的任务,从Object上的每集2.3到LIBERO-10上的10.4.

blocks.en: We read the agent’s message before each of 100 randomly sampled re-entries. In 68 of them the agent re-enters after a step went wrong, such as a grasp that did not close, a descent that stopped short or an object that slipped. In the other 32 it re-enters to prepare the next contact, most often right before a grasp or a release. The sample covers the 77% of re-entries that the agent introduces with a message.
blocks.zh: 我们在100个随机抽取的复诊前, 在其中的68个中,代理在一步出错后重新入住,例如没有关闭的抓取,停止了短暂的下降或滑倒了的物体. 在其他的32个中,它重新进入准备下个接触,最常是在抓取或释放之前的正前方. 样本涵盖代理以信息介绍的77%的再入.

blocks.en: These are almost all on LIBERO-10 and contain 21.2 clip views on average against 4.3 in solved ones. In each the agent keeps re-entering at the same kind of step, most often a grasp or a fixture, without resolving it: watching the demonstration again does not change what the robot can do.
blocks.zh: 这些几乎都在LiBERO-10上,平均有21.2个剪辑视图,而在已解决的剪辑中则有4.3个。 在每种情况下,代理都不断以同样的步骤重新进入,最常是被抓住或固定,而不解决:再次观看演示不会改变机器人所能做的事情.

blocks.en: 5.4 Robustness on LIBERO-Plus
blocks.zh: 5.4 利贝罗-普卢斯的强力

blocks.en: Table 4 reports success on LIBERO-Plus by perturbation dimension. RV-ICL raises overall success from 86.7% to 95.8% and is at least as good as HarnessVLA on every dimension. The largest gain is under changed lighting (76.5 to 94.1), followed by background, robot initial state and camera viewpoint with about 11 points each. Both methods solve every language variant. As on LIBERO-PRO, the gain concentrates in LIBERO-10 (29 of 30 variants solved against 22) and Goal (27 against 23; Table 4 , bottom). It is below HarnessVLA only on Spatial, by one variant.
blocks.zh: 表4按扰动方面报告了LIBERO-Plus的成功情况。 RV-ICL将总体成功率从86.7%提高到95.8%,在每个层面至少与HarnessVLA一样好. 最大的收益是在改变照明下(76.5到94.1),其次是背景,机器人初始状态和相机视角,每部约11分. 两种方法都解决了每个语言变体. 至于LIBERO-PRO,收益集中在LIBERO-10(30个变体中的29个对22个)和Goal(27个对23个;表4,下方)。 它仅位于空间上的HarnesVLA以下,是一个变体。

blocks.en: Table 4: Success rate (%) on LIBERO-Plus by perturbation dimension (top: object layout, camera viewpoint, robot initial state, language, lighting, background and sensor noise) and by suite (bottom). Bold marks the best result in each column.
blocks.zh: 表4:LIBERO-Plus上按扰动维度(顶部:物体布局、相机视角、机器人初始状态、语言、照明、背景和传感器噪音)和套件(下部)分列的成功率(%)。 粗体标出每栏最佳成绩.

blocks.en: Every perturbation separates the episode from the demonstration, which was recorded in the original scene, camera, light and start pose. The demonstration still helps, which fits how the agent uses it: it takes from a clip how a step is done and localises every object in its own camera images. A new viewpoint or light therefore changes what the agent sees in the episode but not what it learns from the clip. Each dimension has only 17 or 18 variants, so one episode moves a cell by about six points. We therefore read Table 4 as evidence that no perturbation breaks RV-ICL , not as a ranking of the dimensions.
blocks.zh: 每一次扰动都会将剧集与演示分开来,在最初的场景,相机,光线和起动姿势中都有收录. 演示还是有帮助的,这符合代理如何使用它:它从一个剪辑中得出一个步骤是如何完成的,并且将自己相机图像中的每个物体定位. 因此,新的观点或光线会改变代理在剧集中所看到的,而不是从片段中吸取的教训. 每个维度只有17个或18个变体,所以一集将一个细胞移动了大约6分. 因此,我们把表4看成没有扰乱RV-ICL的证据,而不是维度的排名。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented Recursive Video In-Context Learning ( RV-ICL ), which gives an LLM robot agent one demonstration of its task as a hierarchy it navigates: coarse levels ground the plan, and during execution the agent returns to the demonstration at the node of its current sub-goal whenever it needs more detail. The approach needs no training and no change to the policy. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, so it applies to any task that decomposes into sub-tasks. On LIBERO-PRO it raises the success rate of HarnessVLA from 92.6% to 96.5%, most of all on the long LIBERO-10 tasks, where keyframes or the whole video add little. Agents re-enter the demonstration in 97% of episodes, mostly to see a grasp or a release. On LIBERO-Plus RV-ICL holds up under all seven kinds of perturbation, and it carries over to a second planner without change. More broadly, treating demonstrations as an environment to be queried, rather than as a prefix, is a natural fit for agents whose information needs change as they act.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了递归视频内在学习(RV-ICL),它向一个LLM机器人代理人演示了它作为它导航的分级任务:粗糙的平面为计划打地平面,在执行过程中,该代理人只要需要更详细的信息,就回到当前子目标的节点演示. 这种做法不需要培训,也不需要改变政策。 分级由演示的子事件所建立,因此适用于分解为子任务的任何任务. 在LIBERO-PRO上,哈内斯VLA的成功率从92.6%提高到96.5%,其中最重要的是在LIBERO-10的长任务上,键框或整个视频增加不多. 特工在97%的节目中重新进入演示,大多是为了看到抓取或释放. 在LIBERO-Plus RV-ICL上,在七种扰动下被支撑起,它无所改变地承接到第二个规划者. 更广泛地说,将示威视为一个需要被质疑的环境,而不是前缀,这自然适合那些在行事时需要改变信息的代理人。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: RV-ICL assumes one demonstration per base task; when a benchmark rewrites the goal of a task, parts of the demonstration become invalid and must be flagged to the agent. On LIBERO we detect sub-events from the gripper and from fixture joints. Tasks whose sub-tasks leave no such trace in the recorded state, such as pushing, wiping or pouring, need another detector, for example one that reads the end-effector trajectory or asks a vision-language model. When contact is executed by a learned skill whose motion differs from the demonstrator’s, the finer levels carry little that the agent can act on.
blocks.zh: RV-ICL承担每个基础任务一个演示;当基准重写任务的目标时,演示的部分会变得无效,必须被标记给代理人. 在LIBERO上,我们检测到来自抓取器和固定关节的子事件. 其子任务在被记录状态下没有留下此类痕迹的任务,如推取,擦取或倒入等,需要另一个探测器,例如读取最终效果器轨迹或询问视觉语言模型的探测器. 当接触被一种与显示器不同动作的学习技能所执行时,更精细的级别携带的代理人几乎无法发挥作用。

blocks.en: Each demonstration view stays in context for the rest of the episode, so cost grows with the number of re-entries. All our experiments use LIBERO tasks with a single robot and a single VLA, so other embodiments and demonstration sources remain untested. Our agents are proprietary models accessed through third-party endpoints, whose behaviour may change over time. Our LIBERO-PRO cells hold 50 episodes and each LIBERO-Plus dimension 17 or 18 variants on one seed, so a single episode moves a cell by two to six points. The baselines in Table 1 come from separate runs, so they cannot be compared with ours episode by episode.
blocks.zh: 每个演示视图都保留在剧集其余部分的上下文中,因此成本随着再入的人数而增加. 我们所有的实验都使用LIBERO任务与单机器人和单VLA,所以其他的活化和演示来源仍然没有经过测试. 我们的代理人是通过第三方端点访问的专有模式,其行为可能随时间而改变。 我们的LIBERO-PRO细胞持有50个分数,每个LIBERO-Plus维度17或18个变种在一个种子上,所以一个分数一个分数移动一个分数2到6分. 表1中的基线来自不同的跑道,因此无法按插曲与我们的插曲进行比较.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: All experiments are conducted in simulation. The LLM agents run shell commands and could read files outside their task; we isolated conditions by restricting directory permissions and audited every shell command afterwards. Deploying such agents on physical robots requires stronger sandboxing and human oversight. Demonstrations are taken from public benchmark datasets.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在模拟中进行的. LLM 代理运行 shell 命令, 并且可以在任务之外读取文件; 我们通过限制目录权限来隔离条件, 并随后审核每个 shell 命令 。 在物理机器人上部署此类物剂需要更有力的沙箱和人类监督。 演示内容取自公共基准数据集。

blocks.en: Both benchmarks reuse the same 40 demonstrations, one per LIBERO base task. Table 7 summarises their hierarchies. blocks.en: RV-ICL changes nothing that is specific to the planner, so the same demonstration hierarchy and tools serve any agent the harness supports. To check this, we run RV-ICL with Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code on LIBERO-PRO with five seeds per task, as in Table 1 , and compare it with GPT-6 Astra in Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot . RV-ICL with Opus 5.5 reaches 94.8% overall, 1.7 points below GPT-6 Astra (96.5%). Both planners solve every episode on Spatial and Object and tie on L10-T, so the gap comes from Goal and L10-S. RV-ICL with Opus 5.5 still scores above every baseline in Table 1 . The method thus carries over to a second planner without any change.
blocks.zh: RV-ICL不会改变任何对规划者有特殊意义的事物,所以同样的演示等级和工具服务于任何被控制者支持的代理人. 为了检查这一点,我们在LIBERO-PRO上的克洛德·奥普斯(Claude Opus)代码中运行了RV-ICL,每个任务有5个种子,如表1,并与GPT-6 Astra在Agentic Robot的递归视频内文学习中进行比较。 带有Opus 5.5的RV-ICL总体达到94.8%,比GPT-6 Astra低1.7分(96.5%). 两位规划者在空间和物体上解决了每集,在L10-T上打平了,因此差距来自Goal和L10-S. RV-ICL,Opus 5.5的分数仍然高于表1的每个基线. 因此,这一方法一直延续到第二个规划者,没有任何改变。

blocks.en: Table 8 compares the cost of an episode with and without the demonstration hierarchy on the 120 LIBERO-Plus variants, which both methods ran in the same time window. RV-ICL takes 1.8 times the wall-clock time and 1.4 times the input tokens of HarnessVLA. For both methods almost nine in ten input tokens are cache hits, because each turn resends the growing context. Demonstration views make up about 21% of the final context of a RV-ICL episode. On LIBERO-PRO a RV-ICL episode takes a median of 11.0 minutes and 1.7M input tokens, and a LIBERO-10 episode 26.2 minutes and 4.2M.
blocks.zh: 表8比较了剧集的成本与120个LIBERO-Plus变体的演示分级,这两种方法在同一时间窗口运行. RV-ICL需要1.8倍于墙钟时间和1.4倍于哈内斯VLA的输入符. 对于这两种方法,几乎十分之九的输入符都是缓存命中,因为每个转动都会重新发送不断增长的上下文. 演示观点占RV-ICL一集最后情节的21%左右. 在LIBERO-PRO上,一集RV-ICL需要中位数为11.0分和1.7M输入符,一集LIBERO-10需要26.2分和4.2M.
